notes: The catalogue usb-cable has no ports, so USB connections use null ports. The open-ended cable's + wire goes to relay 1 NO, and its - wire is joined to the pump's - wire. The edges cannot say which wire is which.
The tutorial text labels the relay on the carrier as relay 1 (NO/COM), but the sketch uses opla.Relay2. I modelled the wiring as relay 1 per the text and circuit images.
The Grove cable pin mapping (1=SIG, 2=NC, 3=VCC, 4=GND) is assumed from the Grove convention. A2/B2 is not connected to the sensor. The sensor's screw terminal has only VCC, GND and SIG.
The MKR board and carrier are joined as one assembly through a single 'MKR' header port on the carrier. Individual header pins are not modelled.
The micro-USB cable goes from the adapter to the MKR board, which powers the board and carrier. The open-ended USB cable goes from the adapter's second port to the pump and relay circuit.
The pump sits in the water container. The pipe's inlet is attached to the pump. The pipe's outlet goes to the plant pot, which is not a part.
The plant, plant pot and phone/cloud dashboard are not modelled as parts.
